subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Should WebChat get a configurable send-shortcut preference, and should that preference live in browser-local UI settings, gateway/openclaw.json config, or both?
rationale: The request is useful but changes settings/config surface and potentially composer defaults, so maintainer product intent is needed before treating a specific implementation as the best fix.

options.title: Use the linked PR path
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/73390 as the implementation candidate, requiring compatibility-preserving defaults and tests for Enter, Shift+Enter, IME composition, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter.

options.title: Narrow to UI-local preference
options.body: Accept a browser-local persisted setting only and avoid a new openclaw.json operator config unless maintainers want centralized policy.

options.title: Decline the shortcut setting
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue as not planned, keeping plain Enter-to-send plus Shift+Enter newline as the WebChat contract.

recommendation.title: Use the linked PR path
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/73390 as the implementation candidate, requiring compatibility-preserving defaults and tests for Enter, Shift+Enter, IME composition, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history and prior review context across the WebChat/settings decision surface.
